Sheet1, row 7
A7 3.0 | C7 This page is affiliated with a news website ([link omitted] and encourages its followers to report individuals they are feel traitors to the country or religion. The page includes personal attacks against individuals ranging from Methodist priests, BQBBS members,  Muslims etc.

A8 4.0 | C8 This page is promoting Sinhala-owned businesses and identifying Muslim-owned ones, urging people to avoid the latter.

A14 10.0 | C14 The name itself is highly offensive; page is dedicated towards attacking Islam
